warning.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover P510e Known Issues by Engine
paragraphs: If your Range Rover P510e has the AJ300P (3.0L I6 + 105kW electric motor) (L663 generation):

Timing chain wear — Ingenium diesel engines share a well-documented timing chain pattern. We replace timing chains, guides and tensioners as standard on every AJ300P (3.0L I6 + 105kW electric motor) rebuild.
warning.source: Source: established specialist consensus, l663.guide specialist buying guide, what-breaks.com. This applies to L663 Defenders only — not to classic Defender models
